clips.title: The story
paras: Vol'jin has ordered the Darkspear trolls to recover the ancient sword Trol'kalar from the ruined human kingdom of Stromgarde. With King Thoras Trollbane fallen, the blade is meant to serve the Horde in future conflicts against the trolls of Zul'Gurub.

Following the death of King Thoras Trollbane and the collapse of Stromgarde into ruin, Chieftain Vol'jin has ordered that every effort be made to spirit Trol'kalar away. This storied blade has long rested in human hands, but the Darkspear tribe hopes to claim it for the battles looming against the jungle trolls dwelling within Zul'Gurub.

To carry out Vol'jin's directive, a seasoned hunter named Zengu was sent to the Horde outpost of Hammerfall, situated in the northeastern reaches of the Arathi Highlands. Nimboya directs travelers from Stranglethorn Vale to seek out Zengu and assist in securing the legendary weapon.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With Thoras Trollbane dead and Stromgarde in ruins, Vol'jin has instructed that we make every effort to spirit the legendary sword Trol'kalar from the humans' hands, so that we might use it in our coming battles against the trolls of Zul'Gurub.
Zengu, one of our seasoned hunters, was dispatched to Hammerfall in northeastern Arathi Highlands to oversee its procurement.

clips.title: Completion
paras: How you doing, adventurer? The task set before us by Vol'jin will be a difficult one, and any assistance you might provide will be appreciated and necessary.
